headline: Firefox is testing an AI Tab that turns web pages into short summaries a reader can scan quickly.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: only the headline is known, so what the test includes and who can see it is unverified.
importance_line: What changed is that Firefox is testing an AI summary tab, which would affect people who read many web pages first, then publishers whose pages get summarised, and the doubt is that the scope of the test and any release plan are not yet reported.
summary: Windows Report reports that Mozilla's Firefox browser is testing an AI Tab that turns websites into scannable summaries.
